subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Telangana.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Hyderabad. Telangana covers a geographic area of 112,077 sq km across 33 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Godavari, Krishna, Manjira, Musi.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's 28th state, formed on 2 June 2014. Hyderabad is an IT powerhouse ('Cyberabad'), pharmaceuticals capital ('Vaccine Capital of the World'), and historic city of pearls.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Telangana.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Telangana was formally instituted on 2 June 2014. Official language(s): Telugu (Classical Language), Urdu.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Perini Sivatandavam (Warrior dance of Kakatiyas), Lambadi.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Bonalu, Bathukamma (Floral festival of women), Sammakka Saralamma Jatara (Medaram).

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Telangana.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Jishnu Dev Varma.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Telangana is A. Revanth Reddy.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court for the State of Telangana (Hyderabad).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Spotted deer (Jinka) | State Bird: Indian roller (Palapitta) | State Flower: Tangedu | State Tree: Jammi.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Telangana.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Coal (Singareni Collieries - SCCL), Limestone, Bauxite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Telangana plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Telangana.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Ramappa Temple (UNESCO World Heritage Site), Charminar, Golconda Fort (Koh-i-Noor source), Warangal Fort.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: KBR National Park, Mahavir Harina Vanasthali, Mrugavani National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Telangana.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Rythu Bharosa, Mahalakshmi Scheme, Gruha Jyothi, Indiramma Indlu.
